# Toolioz — Free Client-Side Utilities & Financial Engineering Suite

> Toolioz (https://toolioz.com) is a free, privacy-first web utility platform offering systematic investment calculators, developer tools, WebAssembly PDF processors, marriage biodata makers, and ATS resume builders. All calculations and file conversions process 100% locally inside client browser memory using JavaScript and WebAssembly (WASM), guaranteeing zero data uploads to external cloud servers.

## Key Financial Calculators & Formulas

- Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/sip-calculator
  - Formula: FV = P × [{(1 + i)^n - 1} / i] × (1 + i)
- Compound Interest Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/compound-interest
  - Formula: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
- Mortgage & Loan Prepayment Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/loan-prepayment
  - Computes exact tenure reduction vs EMI savings on partial principal prepayments.
- Income Tax Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/income-tax
  - Compares New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) vs Old Tax Regime tax liabilities.
- Lumpsum Investment Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/lumpsum-calculator
- Retirement Corpus Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/retirement-corpus

- Marriage Biodata PDF Generator: https://toolioz.com/biodata/biodata-generator
- ATS Resume Generator: https://toolioz.com/pdftools/resume-generator

## Privacy & Security Architecture

- Client-Side Processing: 100% of calculations, image dithering, and PDF manipulation execute in the user's browser sandbox via WebAssembly (WASM) and local JavaScript.
- Zero Server Storage: User documents, financial inputs, JWT keys, and personal biodata details are never transmitted over the network or saved to remote databases.
